---
title: "FACS QC report"
output:
  html_document:
    toc: true
    toc_float: true
params:
  prep: ""
  exclusions: NULL
---

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
prep <- readRDS(params$prep)
info <- prep$info
data <- prep$data
matched <- JanisHelpers::facs_match_exclusions(data, params$exclusions, info$assay)
clashes <- JanisHelpers::facs_check_file_clashes(data)

settings <- JanisHelpers:::qc_settings_(prep)
scored <- JanisHelpers:::qc_score_(data, settings,
                                   excluded_files = matched$excluded_files$file_name)
all_pops <- JanisHelpers:::qc_resolve_(data)$qc_populations
describe_sel <- function(sel, all) {
  if (length(sel) == 0) "none"
  else if (setequal(sel, all)) paste0("all (", length(all), ")")
  else paste(sel, collapse = ", ")
}
or_unset <- function(x) if (is.null(x)) "not set" else paste0("`", x, "`")
conditions <- sort(unique(data$condition))
tissues <- intersect(settings$expected_tissues, unique(data$tissue))

# Print a ggplot (or nothing for NULL) with a height that fits its facet rows.
emit_plot <- function(p) {
  if (is.null(p)) return(invisible(NULL))
  h <- JanisHelpers:::qc_fig_height_(length(unique(p$data$.row)))
  env <- new.env()
  env$p <- p
  # knit_child() switches to the template's folder; switch back afterwards.
  wd <- getwd()
  on.exit(setwd(wd), add = TRUE)
  cat(knitr::knit_child(
    text = c(sprintf("```{r, fig.height = %s, fig.width = 10}", h), "print(p)", "```"),
    envir = env, quiet = TRUE
  ), "\n\n")
}
note <- function(...) cat("\n\n*", ..., "*\n\n", sep = "")
condition_heading <- function(cond, level = "####") {
  if (length(conditions) > 1 || cond != "none") {
    cat("\n\n", level, " Condition: ", cond, "\n\n", sep = "")
  }
}

# One plot check: individuals plot, then one batch plot per tissue.
emit_check <- function(check, population = NULL) {
  for (cond in conditions) {
    condition_heading(cond)
    emit_plot(JanisHelpers:::qc_plot_individuals_(scored, settings, check,
                                                  condition = cond,
                                                  population = population))
    if (is.null(settings$batch_col)) next
    for (tis in tissues) {
      p <- JanisHelpers:::qc_plot_batch_(scored, settings, check, tissue = tis,
                                         condition = cond, population = population)
      if (!is.null(p)) {
        cat("\n\n##### Batch -- ", tis, "\n\n", sep = "")
        emit_plot(p)
      }
    }
  }
}
```

| | |
|---|---|
| Workspace | `r basename(info$wsp_path)` |
| Root / version | `r info$wsp_root` / `r format(info$wsp_version)` |
| Panel (assay) | `r info$assay` |
| Prep result created | `r format(info$created_at, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")` |
| JanisHelpers | `r info$package_version` |
| Group / batch column | `r or_unset(settings$group_col)` / `r or_unset(settings$batch_col)` |
| QC populations | `r describe_sel(settings$qc_populations, all_pops)` |
| MFI populations / markers | `r describe_sel(settings$qc_mfi_populations, all_pops)` / `r describe_sel(settings$qc_metrics, settings$qc_metrics)` |

All samples are shown. Rows on the exclusions sheet are only flagged here;
they are dropped at the final export.

## Files

```{r files}
files <- data |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_populations = dplyr::n_distinct(population_full_path),
    .by = c(file_name, mouse_ID, tissue, condition)
  ) |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    dplyr::rename(matched$excluded_files, excluded = reason),
    by = "file_name"
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(excluded = dplyr::coalesce(excluded, "")) |>
  dplyr::arrange(mouse_ID, tissue, condition)
knitr::kable(files)
```

## Keyword clashes

```{r clashes, results = "asis"}
if (nrow(clashes) == 0) {
  cat("None -- every mouse_ID x tissue x condition comes from one file.\n")
} else {
  cat("**Warning: these files share one mouse_ID x tissue x condition.**",
      "Fix the keywords in FlowJo; the final export refuses until then.\n\n")
  print(knitr::kable(clashes))
}
```

## Exclusions

```{r exclusions, results = "asis"}
if (nrow(matched$applicable) == 0) {
  cat("No exclusions apply to this panel.\n")
} else {
  print(knitr::kable(matched$applicable))
}
ex <- params$exclusions
if (!is.null(ex) && nrow(ex) > 0 && "panel" %in% names(ex)) {
  other <- ex[!is.na(ex$panel) & as.character(ex$panel) != info$assay, ]
  if (nrow(other) > 0) {
    cat("\n\n### Rows for other panels (ignored here)\n\n",
        "Check the panel name if one of these was meant for '", info$assay,
        "'.\n\n", sep = "")
    print(knitr::kable(other))
  }
}
if (nrow(matched$unmatched) > 0) {
  cat("\n\n### Warning: these rows match no file\n\n",
      "Check for typos -- the final export stops on them.\n\n")
  print(knitr::kable(matched$unmatched))
}
```

## QC checks

Outlier labels: robust z (median / MAD, logit scale for fractions, log10 for
counts and MFIs) above 3.5 within group x tissue x population. Not scored:
populations under 50 events, boxes with fewer than 4 samples, MFIs <= 0.
Excluded samples are scored but don't feed the box median / MAD.

```{r no-group, results = "asis"}
if (is.null(settings$group_col)) {
  note("Group column not set -- rerun the prep script with `group_col` to score outliers.")
}
```

### Completeness

```{r completeness, results = "asis"}
comp <- JanisHelpers:::qc_completeness_(data, settings)
if (is.null(comp)) {
  note("Expected mice not set -- rerun the prep script with `expected_mice`.")
} else {
  cat(comp$n_expected, " expected samples, ", comp$n_present, " present.\n\n", sep = "")
  if (nrow(comp$missing) == 0) {
    cat("None missing.\n")
  } else {
    print(knitr::kable(comp$missing, caption = "Missing samples"))
  }
}
```

### Gating hierarchy

Fraction of parent.

```{r hierarchy, results = "asis"}
emit_check("hierarchy")
```

### Raw counts

```{r counts, results = "asis"}
emit_check("counts")
```

### MFI

```{r mfi, results = "asis"}
if (length(settings$qc_mfi_populations) == 0) {
  note("No MFI populations selected (`qc_mfi_populations` in the prep script).")
} else {
  for (pop in settings$qc_mfi_populations) {
    cat("\n\n#### ", pop, "\n\n", sep = "")
    if (!any(scored$check == "mfi" & as.character(scored$population) == pop)) {
      note("No MFI values for this population.")
      next
    }
    emit_check("mfi", population = pop)
  }
}
```

### Flagged samples

```{r flags, results = "asis"}
if (is.null(settings$group_col)) {
  note("Not scored -- group column not set.")
} else {
  flags <- JanisHelpers:::qc_flag_table_(scored, settings)
  if (nrow(flags) == 0) {
    cat("No samples flagged.\n")
  } else {
    cat("Score = number of distinct tissue x condition x check combinations",
        "flagged for the mouse; every flagged value is listed.\n\n")
    flags$value <- signif(flags$value, 3)
    flags$z <- round(flags$z, 1)
    flags$excluded <- ifelse(flags$excluded, "excluded", "")
    print(knitr::kable(flags))
  }
}
```
